column3: Public SEO and static resources intentionally use their own cache policy
Pinned Supabase CDN script is protected by SRI and the CSP allowlist
Credentials and personal data must not be sent in a URL
Public and API responses intentionally include non-storable content
Public static resources may be served from Vercel cache
Host-scoped wildcards are required for configured analytics and user images
The detected Base64 value is the public Supabase anon key
CORS on public static resources does not grant access to authenticated APIs
The public login form is intentionally recognized as authentication
State-changing APIs enforce same-origin requests and authenticated routes also require a bearer token
Supabase JavaScript uses SRI; Google Fonts returns browser-specific CSS without a stable SRI hash
COEP require-corp is incompatible with OAuth and embedded product integrations
Sec-Fetch-Dest is a browser request header, not a server response control
